opinions.text: its fun cuddly cute and unforgiving when you died if you die your inventory is lost and all upgrades make you reset to the beginiing of your run the town lvl stays the same so you will have the same progress its just all upgrades are lost give it a try its fun to play and cozy i cried when i died cuz i lost all my good stuff :( i rate it 10/10

opinions.text: 怎么说呢，画风确实很可爱，但游戏表现比较平庸，奖励也没有成就感，总之就是来来回回折返，人物又不能加速移动，很需要耐心，而且引导有些不足，比如我升级一个建筑需要8费金币，但我上限5费不知道怎么办，直接卡住我了，望正式版得到调整。
